# Data dictionary

<!-- Generated by `lakehouse docs dictionary` from the silver column specs. Do not edit by hand; CI fails if this file is stale. -->

Every column of every silver table, with its type, where it comes from and what it
means. Types are read from real (empty) builds, so they match the database exactly.

**Origin**: `field` (kind) = typed from that raw bronze field with the given cleaning
kind ([typing rules](silver-crimes.md#cleaning-rules)); **derived** = computed from
other columns; **lineage** = carried from bronze; **geo** = added by
[geo cleanup](geo-cleanup.md).

| Table | Grain | Columns |
|---|---|---|
| [`silver.crimes`](#silvercrimes) | One row per crime (`crime_id`); latest bronze version of each record. | 31 |
| [`silver.service_requests`](#silverservice_requests) | One row per 311 service request (`sr_number`); latest bronze version of each record. | 33 |
| [`silver.taxi_trips`](#silvertaxi_trips) | One row per taxi trip (`trip_id`); latest bronze version of each record. | 43 |

## silver.crimes

One row per crime (`crime_id`); latest bronze version of each record. Source: `bronze.chicago_crimes__latest`. Details: [silver-crimes.md](silver-crimes.md).

| Column | Type | Origin | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `crime_id` | BIGINT | `id` (int) | Unique crime record ID |
| `case_number` | VARCHAR | `case_number` (upper) | CPD Records Division number |
| `occurred_at` | TIMESTAMP | `date` (timestamp) | When the incident occurred (Chicago local time, no time zone) |
| `updated_at` | TIMESTAMP | `updated_on` (timestamp) | Last update on the portal |
| `year` | BIGINT | `year` (int) | Year of the incident |
| `block` | VARCHAR | `block` (upper) | Partially redacted address block |
| `iucr` | VARCHAR | `iucr` (code) | Illinois Uniform Crime Reporting code |
| `primary_type` | VARCHAR | `primary_type` (upper) | Primary IUCR category |
| `description` | VARCHAR | `description` (upper) | IUCR secondary description |
| `location_description` | VARCHAR | `location_description` (upper) | Kind of location |
| `arrest` | BOOLEAN | `arrest` (bool) | Whether an arrest was made |
| `domestic` | BOOLEAN | `domestic` (bool) | Domestic-related incident |
| `beat` | VARCHAR | `beat` (code) | Police beat |
| `district` | BIGINT | `district` (int) | Police district number |
| `ward` | BIGINT | `ward` (int) | City Council ward |
| `community_area` | BIGINT | `community_area` (int) | Community area (1-77) |
| `fbi_code` | VARCHAR | `fbi_code` (upper) | FBI NIBRS offense code |
| `x_coordinate` | DOUBLE | `x_coordinate` (double) | State Plane Illinois East (feet) |
| `y_coordinate` | DOUBLE | `y_coordinate` (double) | State Plane Illinois East (feet) |
| `latitude` | DOUBLE | `latitude` (double) | WGS84 latitude |
| `longitude` | DOUBLE | `longitude` (double) | WGS84 longitude |
| `record_key` | VARCHAR | lineage | Bronze record key (the source primary key as text) |
| `run_id` | VARCHAR | lineage | Ingestion run that landed this version of the record |
| `ingested_at` | TIMESTAMP | lineage | When that version was ingested into bronze (UTC) |
| `silver_built_at` | TIMESTAMP | lineage | When the silver build that wrote this row ran (UTC) |
| `geo_status` | VARCHAR | geo | Coordinate check: ok, missing, null_island, swapped, out_of_range or outside_chicago |
| `latitude_clean` | DOUBLE | geo | Usable latitude (swapped pairs corrected; NULL unless ok/swapped) |
| `longitude_clean` | DOUBLE | geo | Usable longitude (swapped pairs corrected; NULL unless ok/swapped) |
| `community_area_geo` | INTEGER | geo | Community area whose polygon contains the clean point (needs --areas) |
| `community_area_mismatch` | BOOLEAN | geo | Reported community area differs from the geometric one (needs --areas) |
| `community_area_resolved` | INTEGER | geo | Reported community area if valid (1-77), else the geometric one (needs --areas) |

## silver.service_requests

One row per 311 service request (`sr_number`); latest bronze version of each record. Source: `bronze.chicago_311_requests__latest`. Details: [silver-311.md](silver-311.md).

| Column | Type | Origin | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sr_number` | VARCHAR | `sr_number` (upper) | Service request number |
| `sr_type` | VARCHAR | `sr_type` (upper) | Request type |
| `sr_short_code` | VARCHAR | `sr_short_code` (upper) | Request type code |
| `owner_department` | VARCHAR | `owner_department` (upper) | Department responsible |
| `status_raw` | VARCHAR | `status` (text) | Status exactly as published |
| `origin` | VARCHAR | `origin` (upper) | Channel the request came in through |
| `created_at` | TIMESTAMP | `created_date` (timestamp) | When the request was created (Chicago local time) |
| `last_modified_at` | TIMESTAMP | `last_modified_date` (timestamp) | Last modification on the portal |
| `closed_at` | TIMESTAMP | `closed_date` (timestamp) | When the request was closed |
| `street_address` | VARCHAR | `street_address` (upper) | Address of the request |
| `zip_code` | VARCHAR | `zip_code` (code) | ZIP code |
| `duplicate` | BOOLEAN | `duplicate` (bool) | Flagged as a duplicate request |
| `legacy_record` | BOOLEAN | `legacy_record` (bool) | Migrated from the legacy 311 system |
| `parent_sr_number` | VARCHAR | `parent_sr_number` (upper) | Parent request for duplicates |
| `community_area` | BIGINT | `community_area` (int) | Community area (1-77) |
| `ward` | BIGINT | `ward` (int) | City Council ward |
| `police_district` | BIGINT | `police_district` (int) | Police district |
| `latitude` | DOUBLE | `latitude` (double) | WGS84 latitude |
| `longitude` | DOUBLE | `longitude` (double) | WGS84 longitude |
| `record_key` | VARCHAR | lineage | Bronze record key (the source primary key as text) |
| `run_id` | VARCHAR | lineage | Ingestion run that landed this version of the record |
| `ingested_at` | TIMESTAMP | lineage | When that version was ingested into bronze (UTC) |
| `silver_built_at` | TIMESTAMP | lineage | When the silver build that wrote this row ran (UTC) |
| `status` | VARCHAR | derived | Canonical status: OPEN, COMPLETED, CANCELED or UNKNOWN (from `status_raw`) |
| `is_open` | BOOLEAN | derived | `status = 'OPEN'` |
| `is_duplicate` | BOOLEAN | derived | Duplicate flag set, or a '... - Dup' status |
| `resolution_hours` | DOUBLE | derived | Hours from `created_at` to `closed_at` (NULL if either is missing or closed precedes created) |
| `geo_status` | VARCHAR | geo | Coordinate check: ok, missing, null_island, swapped, out_of_range or outside_chicago |
| `latitude_clean` | DOUBLE | geo | Usable latitude (swapped pairs corrected; NULL unless ok/swapped) |
| `longitude_clean` | DOUBLE | geo | Usable longitude (swapped pairs corrected; NULL unless ok/swapped) |
| `community_area_geo` | INTEGER | geo | Community area whose polygon contains the clean point (needs --areas) |
| `community_area_mismatch` | BOOLEAN | geo | Reported community area differs from the geometric one (needs --areas) |
| `community_area_resolved` | INTEGER | geo | Reported community area if valid (1-77), else the geometric one (needs --areas) |

Quality checks (rows counted, never dropped):

- `unknown_status`: `status = 'UNKNOWN'`
- `open_with_closed_date`: `status = 'OPEN' AND closed_at IS NOT NULL`
- `completed_without_closed_date`: `status = 'COMPLETED' AND closed_at IS NULL`
- `closed_before_created`: `closed_at < created_at`

## silver.taxi_trips

One row per taxi trip (`trip_id`); latest bronze version of each record. Source: `bronze.chicago_taxi_trips__latest`. Details: [silver-taxi.md](silver-taxi.md).

| Column | Type | Origin | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `trip_id` | VARCHAR | `trip_id` (text) | Unique trip ID |
| `taxi_id` | VARCHAR | `taxi_id` (text) | Anonymised taxi ID |
| `trip_start_at` | TIMESTAMP | `trip_start_timestamp` (timestamp) | Trip start, rounded to 15 minutes (Chicago local time) |
| `trip_end_at` | TIMESTAMP | `trip_end_timestamp` (timestamp) | Trip end, rounded to 15 minutes (Chicago local time) |
| `trip_seconds` | BIGINT | `trip_seconds` (int) | Trip duration in seconds |
| `trip_miles` | DOUBLE | `trip_miles` (double) | Trip distance in miles |
| `pickup_census_tract` | VARCHAR | `pickup_census_tract` (text) | Pickup census tract (often blank for privacy) |
| `dropoff_census_tract` | VARCHAR | `dropoff_census_tract` (text) | Dropoff census tract |
| `pickup_community_area` | BIGINT | `pickup_community_area` (int) | Pickup community area (1-77) |
| `dropoff_community_area` | BIGINT | `dropoff_community_area` (int) | Dropoff community area (1-77) |
| `fare` | DOUBLE | `fare` (double) | Fare in dollars |
| `tips` | DOUBLE | `tips` (double) | Tip in dollars |
| `tolls` | DOUBLE | `tolls` (double) | Tolls in dollars |
| `extras` | DOUBLE | `extras` (double) | Extra charges in dollars |
| `trip_total` | DOUBLE | `trip_total` (double) | Total charged in dollars |
| `payment_type` | VARCHAR | `payment_type` (upper) | Payment method |
| `company` | VARCHAR | `company` (upper) | Taxi company |
| `pickup_latitude` | DOUBLE | `pickup_centroid_latitude` (double) | Pickup census-tract (or area) centroid latitude |
| `pickup_longitude` | DOUBLE | `pickup_centroid_longitude` (double) | Pickup centroid longitude |
| `dropoff_latitude` | DOUBLE | `dropoff_centroid_latitude` (double) | Dropoff centroid latitude |
| `dropoff_longitude` | DOUBLE | `dropoff_centroid_longitude` (double) | Dropoff centroid longitude |
| `record_key` | VARCHAR | lineage | Bronze record key (the source primary key as text) |
| `run_id` | VARCHAR | lineage | Ingestion run that landed this version of the record |
| `ingested_at` | TIMESTAMP | lineage | When that version was ingested into bronze (UTC) |
| `silver_built_at` | TIMESTAMP | lineage | When the silver build that wrote this row ran (UTC) |
| `duration_minutes` | DOUBLE | derived | `trip_seconds / 60`, else end minus start, in minutes |
| `avg_speed_mph` | DOUBLE | derived | Average speed in miles per hour (when `trip_seconds > 0`) |
| `fare_per_mile` | DOUBLE | derived | `fare / trip_miles` (when `trip_miles > 0`) |
| `tip_pct` | DOUBLE | derived | Tip as a percentage of the fare (when `fare > 0`) |
| `outlier_reasons` | VARCHAR[] | derived | Names of the outlier rules this trip breaks (empty if none) |
| `is_outlier` | BOOLEAN | derived | TRUE when `outlier_reasons` is not empty |
| `pickup_geo_status` | VARCHAR | geo | Coordinate check: ok, missing, null_island, swapped, out_of_range or outside_chicago (pickup) |
| `pickup_latitude_clean` | DOUBLE | geo | Usable latitude (swapped pairs corrected; NULL unless ok/swapped) (pickup) |
| `pickup_longitude_clean` | DOUBLE | geo | Usable longitude (swapped pairs corrected; NULL unless ok/swapped) (pickup) |
| `pickup_community_area_geo` | INTEGER | geo | Community area whose polygon contains the clean point (needs --areas) (pickup) |
| `pickup_community_area_mismatch` | BOOLEAN | geo | Reported community area differs from the geometric one (needs --areas) (pickup) |
| `pickup_community_area_resolved` | INTEGER | geo | Reported community area if valid (1-77), else the geometric one (needs --areas) (pickup) |
| `dropoff_geo_status` | VARCHAR | geo | Coordinate check: ok, missing, null_island, swapped, out_of_range or outside_chicago (dropoff) |
| `dropoff_latitude_clean` | DOUBLE | geo | Usable latitude (swapped pairs corrected; NULL unless ok/swapped) (dropoff) |
| `dropoff_longitude_clean` | DOUBLE | geo | Usable longitude (swapped pairs corrected; NULL unless ok/swapped) (dropoff) |
| `dropoff_community_area_geo` | INTEGER | geo | Community area whose polygon contains the clean point (needs --areas) (dropoff) |
| `dropoff_community_area_mismatch` | BOOLEAN | geo | Reported community area differs from the geometric one (needs --areas) (dropoff) |
| `dropoff_community_area_resolved` | INTEGER | geo | Reported community area if valid (1-77), else the geometric one (needs --areas) (dropoff) |

Quality checks (rows counted, never dropped):

- `is_outlier`: `is_outlier`
- `outlier_negative_amount`: `list_contains(outlier_reasons, 'negative_amount')`
- `outlier_nonpositive_duration`: `list_contains(outlier_reasons, 'nonpositive_duration')`
- `outlier_too_long_duration`: `list_contains(outlier_reasons, 'too_long_duration')`
- `outlier_too_long_distance`: `list_contains(outlier_reasons, 'too_long_distance')`
- `outlier_implausible_speed`: `list_contains(outlier_reasons, 'implausible_speed')`
- `outlier_zero_distance_with_fare`: `list_contains(outlier_reasons, 'zero_distance_with_fare')`
- `outlier_extreme_total`: `list_contains(outlier_reasons, 'extreme_total')`
- `outlier_total_mismatch`: `list_contains(outlier_reasons, 'total_mismatch')`

## Reference tables

Loaded from `seeds/` ([reference data](reference-data.md)); each also has a `<name>_history` SCD2 table ([SCD2](scd2.md)).

- `reference.community_areas`: Chicago's 77 official community areas. Key `community_area`. Columns: `community_area` INTEGER, `name` VARCHAR.
- `reference.police_districts`: Current Chicago Police Department districts. Key `district`. Columns: `district` INTEGER, `name` VARCHAR.
